title: International City record in Mississippi with Bob Robin
summary: Ridgley wrote lyrics to pre-taped tracks at Huey Meaux's Mississippi studio, with white musicians and a Motown feel; My Love Gets Stronger.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
